description: Manage Shopee products, orders, logistics, returns, and merchant data.

clientConfigFields.label: Authorization Base URL
clientConfigFields.description: Use https://open.shopee.cn for production or https://open.sandbox.test-stable.shopee.cn for sandbox.

clientConfigFields.label: API Base URL
clientConfigFields.description: Use https://partner.shopeemobile.com for production or https://openplatform.sandbox.test-stable.shopee.sg for sandbox.

steps: Create a Shopee Open Platform app and register the callback URL shown below.
Copy the Partner ID into Client ID and the Partner Key into Client Secret.
Keep both endpoint fields on production, or switch both to their documented sandbox values.

actions.name: create_global_item

merchantId.description: The Shopee merchant ID. Omit it when the connection has exactly one merchant.

items.description: A Shopee Media Space image ID.

imageIds.description: Shopee Media Space image IDs for the product.

originalPrice.description: The original global product price in the merchant base currency.

stock.description: The available normal stock for the product.

daysToShip.description: The number of days needed to ship the product.

valueId.description: The predefined Shopee attribute value ID, or 0 for a custom value.

originalValueName.description: The predefined or custom attribute value name.

valueUnit.description: The unit for a quantitative attribute value.

items.description: A value assigned to a Shopee global product attribute.

values.description: The values selected for this attribute.

items.description: A Shopee global product attribute and its selected values.

attributes.description: The product attributes required by its category.

locationId.description: The Shopee seller stock location ID.

stock.description: The available stock at this location.

items.description: Stock held at a Shopee seller stock location.

sellerStock.description: Stock allocated to Shopee seller stock locations.

inputSchema.description: The product information used to create a Shopee global product draft.

requestId.description: The Shopee request ID used for upstream error tracking.

data.description: The response data returned by Shopee Open Platform.

outputSchema.description: A normalized Shopee Open Platform response.
